title: Stop Saying "Very Poor"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very poor". Use one of these words instead:
• Impoverished: an impoverished country
• Destitute: left destitute
• Penniless: a penniless student
• Broke: flat broke
• Needy: a needy family

Comment your own word for "very poor"!
